text.p: Inco Ltd and Nuinsco Resources Ltd said on Monday they have mutually agreed to terminate the existing option-joint venture deal covering Nuinsco's Rainy River property which Inco inherited when it acquired Diamond Fields Resources Inc.

Under Monday's agreement, Inco has agreed not to exercise or transfer a warrant originally issued to Diamond Fields to purchase up to two million Nuinsco common shares at C$1.25 per share prior to its expiry date, October 23.
Inco's two representatives on Nuinsco's board will resign immediately.
Inco has agreed to work with Nuinsco over the next 60 days to find one or more investors to buy the two million Nuinsco common shares Inco also succeeded to upon its acquisition of Diamond Fields.

The companies said Nuinsco has been advised that Inco's decision to terminate the Rainy River option-joint venture agreement was based on Inco's intention to focus on the Voisey's Bay deposit and other opportunities it has been devoting resources to for some time.
Nuinsco intends to continue to aggressively explore and develop the Rainy River property.
